Owner-requested planning (outside the one-phase rule; no story started): the owner adopted the design docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-26-one-engine-sector-lenses-design.md (decisions D1-D7), which retires the per-sector graphs. Code inspection at 0b3ebb9 found: all five graphs already run one bundle plus one reasoning-model call, with the LangGraph worker pool only a fallback (about 3,800 fallback-only lines); five scoring schemes with 37 dimension slots under 24 names; the LLM re-scores numbers the code computed (RSI/MACD/peer P/E); generic-graph stocks are valued against automobile peers (_sector_peer_tickers('generic','SUNPHARMA') -> MARUTI, TATAMOTORS, M&M, HEROMOTOCO, BAJAJ-AUTO); missing data is scored 0.5; sector membership is a hand-typed list. The design is one engine: lens YAML per industry (NSE-industry resolution, real peers, benchmark, KPIs, frozen store keys); five computed factors (Value, Quality, Growth, Momentum, Risk) as percentiles against peers and own history; one LLM reader returning dated, sourced events, with Catalyst computed by code; composite at equal weights (1/6); no directional verdict below 4 of 6 factors; the LLM explains but cannot decide. Learning uses six pooled factor weights, not per-ticker weights. The engine switches on non-inferiority (effective disagreements >= 100 over >= 2 months and >= 3 lenses, right on >= 50%, no lens < 40% with >= 20, two consecutive looks); learning still needs superiority. Board: new SA-044 (peer fix, S2, 2), SA-045 (factors, S4, 5), SA-046 (reader, S4, 3), SA-047 (decide, shadow and switch, S5, 5); SA-026 retitled 'Consolidate sector definitions into sector lenses', P2 -> P1, S6 -> S3; SA-043 learns pooled factor weights, S3 -> S4, and now also depends on SA-045; SA-022 also depends on SA-047; SA-027 also depends on SA-047 and retires the sector packages, LangGraph pool and five prompts. Owner-requested planning (outside the one-phase rule; no story started): how to know when learning may leave observe. The owner adopted a shadow-learner design. Code inspection found that SA-039's observe mode re-proposes one step from the frozen stored weights every night (v41 -> v42 each time), so nothing accumulates to evaluate. New SA-043 (P1, Sprint 3, 3 points; depends on SA-015 and SA-039): in observe the review updates a separate shadow weight file that starts from the sector default table (never the stored pre-fix weights), with an evidence_start date. For each SA-014 frozen decision it records default and shadow composites and verdicts from the same agent scores, with the shadow version in force at issue time and no look-ahead. Worked example, generic graph with BUY >= 0.55: all agents 0.5 and technical 0.9 give 0.548 NEUTRAL with the default 0.12 and 0.58 BUY with a shadow 0.20. SA-022 is amended (points unchanged; now also depends on SA-043) with predeclared promotion gates scored on effective disagreements (SA-020): at least 100 over at least 3 months and at least 3 sectors; the shadow right on at least 60%; wins in 2 of the last 3 months and robust to dropping the best sector; sane weights (no agent at its bound or below half its default for 4 weeks, within SA-015 bounds). A pass must hold at two consecutive monthly looks, and the report never auto-promotes. Promotion is an owner decision at a month start: adapt resumes from the shadow weights, never the stored pre-fix weights (archived), through a reviewed migration. Then a reverse tally: fewer than 45% of at least 30 effective disagreements in the first full month returns to observe. This settles the SA-039 card's resume question (dated note added). Planned stories 40 / 143 points (Sprint 3: 21). KT sections 1, 5 and 12 and the PI README are updated and the PDF rebuilt.
